vibe: Objective, rigid, functional, high-security command center

fonts.import_instructions: Import via Google Fonts or Fontsource. Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-neutral-950

colors.notes: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. All grays are slightly tinted. Primary CTA is Stark Black. No generic gradients. Color is used strictly for function (status indicators) and not for decoration.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Generous internal padding required (p-6, p-8, p-12). Never cramp text near borders.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align paragraphs, labels, and dense content. Center-align only major empty states or specific modal headers.
spacing_and_layout.borders: 1px solid borders on everything. No soft drop shadows. Expose the structural skeleton.
spacing_and_layout.radii: rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px). Strict, sharp, architectural look.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (surface), 1px solid border (border_strong), zero shadow. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
surface_strategies.login_hero: Use the provided abstract architecture image with a heavy white/light overlay (bg-white/80) so the login card floats clearly. High contrast text.
surface_strategies.tables_and_logs: border-collapse. Use clear border-b on rows. Hover state on rows must explicitly change bg (hover:bg-neutral-100) and text color.
surface_strategies.modals: Solid white background. Thick black 2px border. shadow-[8px_8px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] for a slight neo-brutalist grounding.

components.general: Use Shadcn primitives but customize to be flat, cardless where possible, with sharp edges.
components.buttons: Square edges (rounded-none). High contrast. primary: bg-neutral-950 text-white hover:bg-neutral-800. secondary: bg-white border border-neutral-300 hover:bg-neutral-100.
components.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input. rounded-none. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-neutral-950 focus:border-neutral-950. No subtle blue glow. Sharp focus.
components.select_and_dropdown: Shadcn primitives. Square edges. High contrast hover states.
components.badges: For RBAC roles. Small, uppercase, mono font. e.g., border border-neutral-950 bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-900.
components.toast: Use Sonner. Customize styling to match the sharp, white-theme brutalist-lite aesthetic. 1px black border.

icons.library: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense data clarity and a technical look. Use 'regular' or 'bold' weight depending on context.

image_urls.description: Abstract macro photography of white architectural folds. Use as the full-screen background for the Login page with a slight white semi-transparent overlay to ensure the login card stands out.
Minimalist flat geometric logo icon. Use in the header/nav bar and login screen above the title.

motion.transitions: Fast and deliberate. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.hover_states: Must explicitly set text color and background on hover. E.g. hover:bg-neutral-950 hover:text-white.
motion.loading: Use mono text blinkers or stark linear progress bars instead of generic spinning circles.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Maintain APCA / WCAG AA minimums. Black text on white/gray.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (login form, send items form, status buttons, table filters) MUST have a data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='send-item-input'.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Implement the frontend strictly according to these E1 design guidelines. Overwrite default Shadcn soft radii and subtle shadows with sharp (rounded-none) and flat borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the Login Page, use the 'login_background' image behind the authentication form. Ensure the layout remains strictly 'White Clean Theme'.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: The Admin Dashboard should use a heavy data-focused layout (Mode B). The sidebar or top nav must use the 'secure_admin_logo'.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Ensure the 'Send Items' form, 'Server Status Control', and 'User Management' sections use generous padding and clear visual hierarchy (h2/h3 separation max 2 steps).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Logs Viewer must use mono font for timestamps and IDs, organized via a strict grid table.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add data-testid attributes to EVERY button, input, tab, and navigation link.
